identification: Two small framed black-and-white relief prints by Joan Kelly (per catalogue), catalogued as etchings but the white-line cutting looks like wood engraving, linocut or scraperboard: (1) moonlit bush scene, trees against a hill, full moon top right, flowers in foreground lightly hand-tinted yellow, image about 8 x 11 cm, silver frame with black slip mat; (2) vase of lilies on a tiled table before a curtained window, image about 6 x 8 cm (portrait), double white mat, dark frame. Estimate 30-50.

entries.note: Signed and numbered Australian etching (Queenslander house, 16/200), framed, Best Offer accepted. Same class: minor Australian printmaker, framed small print.
Framed signed and numbered limited edition print, seascape.
